# Access matrix: Classic Pages

<!-- Generated by pageslens from the site configuration. Do not edit by hand; run `pageslens docs` again. -->

Which web role can do what on which table, from the table permissions in the site. The roles marked "every visitor" and "every signed-in user" are given automatically, so a signed-in user has the grants of their own roles plus those of the signed-in role.

Privileges: R read · W write · C create · D delete · A append · T append to.

No table permission gives any web role access to a table.

## Grants by role

### Administrators

No table permissions.

No table permissions.
